mistakes: Letting the front knee cave in.
Taking steps that are too short.
exercises.note: Use a pair of dumbbells you can hold safely, and clear the space in front of you.

exercises.name: Back Extension (Dumbbell)
setup: Set the pad at hip height and tuck your ankles under the rollers.
Hold a light dumbbell against your chest.
steps: Lower your torso until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Raise your torso until your body is in a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top without arching.
mistakes: Arching past a straight line at the top.
Using too much weight for your back.
exercises.note: Stop at a straight body line, not an arch, and start with bodyweight before adding a dumbbell.

exercises.name: Cossack Squat (Dumbbell)
setup: Stand with your feet wide and toes turned out slightly, holding a dumbbell at your chest.
Keep your chest up.
steps: Shift to one side and squat deep on that leg.
Keep the other leg straight.
Push through your heel to return to the middle and switch sides.
mistakes: Rounding your back as you go down.
exercises.note: Use a modest weight and a comfortable depth, and hold a support if you need balance.

exercises.name: Cross Body Romanian Deadlift (Dumbbell)
setup: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in one hand.
Soften your knees and keep your chest up.
steps: Hinge at the hips and lower the dumbbell toward the opposite foot, keeping your back flat.
Pause when you feel a hamstring stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
exercises.note: Keep the weight light enough that you can hinge without rounding your back.

exercises.name: Decline Chest Fly (Dumbbell)
setup: Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured and a dumbbell in each hand above your chest, palms facing each other.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
steps: Open your arms out to the sides in a wide arc until you feel a stretch across your chest.
Squeeze the dumbbells back together above your chest.
Keep the elbow angle fixed the whole time.
mistakes: Bending your elbows so it becomes a press.
Lowering too far and straining the shoulders.
Using weights that are too heavy.
exercises.note: Use lighter dumbbells than you would for a press, and get them into position carefully with help if needed.

exercises.name: Decline Crunch (Behind Head) (Dumbbell)
setup: Lie on a decline bench with your feet hooked under the pad.
Hold a light dumbbell behind or beside your head, not pulling on your neck.
steps: Curl your torso up by flexing your abs.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly with control.
mistakes: Pulling on your neck with your hands.
exercises.note: Hold the weight lightly against your chest, avoid jerking up, and stop if you feel strain in your neck or lower back.

exercises.name: Decline Skullcrusher (Dumbbell)
setup: Lie on a decline bench holding the dumbbells above your chest with your feet secured.
Plant your elbows above your shoulders.
steps: Bend your elbows to lower the dumbbells toward the sides of your head.
Stop when you feel a stretch in the back of your arms.
Extend your elbows back to the start.
mistakes: Letting the dumbbells drift toward your face.
exercises.note: Lower the dumbbells carefully to the sides of your head, not onto your face, and use a spotter for heavy sets.

exercises.name: Farmer Carry (Dumbbell)
setup: Pick up a heavy dumbbell in each hand and stand tall, shoulders back and down.
Keep your arms straight at your sides.
steps: Walk with short, quick steps for a set distance or time.
Keep your ribs stacked over your hips.
Set the weights down under control.
mistakes: Leaning to one side or shrugging up.
Letting the dumbbells swing into your legs.
Dropping the weights from standing height.
exercises.note: Clear the path first and set the weights down by bending the knees, not rounding the back.

exercises.name: Feet Elevated Glute Bridge (Dumbbell)
setup: Lie with your upper back on the floor and your heels on a bench, knees bent.
Rest a dumbbell on your hips and hold it with both hands.
steps: Drive through your heels to lift your hips until knees, hips and shoulders line up.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly without touching down fully.
mistakes: Arching the lower back to get higher.
exercises.note: Roll the dumbbell onto the hips carefully, and use a pad if the weight presses on the bone.

exercises.name: Figure Four Heels Elevated Hip Thrust (Dumbbell)
setup: Sit with your upper back against a bench, dumbbell on your hips.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee in a figure-four shape, standing foot flat.
steps: Drive through the standing foot heel to lift your hips.
Hold and squeeze at the top.
Lower with control, then switch sides.
mistakes: Hips twisting toward the crossed leg.
exercises.note: Do the same reps on both sides, starting with the weaker side.

exercises.name: Front Squat (Dumbbell)
setup: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your shoulders, palms facing in, elbows pointing forward.
Feet shoulder width.
steps: Sit down between your hips, keeping your chest tall.
Pause at thighs parallel.
Stand by pushing through your whole foot.
mistakes: Elbows dropping so the weights fall forward.
exercises.note: Be ready to drop the dumbbells sideways if you get stuck.

exercises.name: Front Squat (Tempo) (Dumbbell)
setup: Hold dumbbells at your shoulders, elbows forward.
Count a 3-second lowering in your head.
steps: Lower for three seconds.
Pause for one second at the bottom.
Stand up in about one second.
mistakes: Dropping the last half of the lowering.
exercises.note: Tempo reps are harder, so use less weight than a normal front squat.

exercises.name: Goblet Alternating Curtsy Lunge (Dumbbell)
setup: Hold one dumbbell at your chest.
Stand with feet hip width.
steps: Step one leg behind and across the other, as if curtsying.
Lower the back knee toward the floor.
Push off the front foot to stand and switch sides.
mistakes: Stepping so far across you lose balance.
exercises.note: Hold the dumbbell firmly and step into a clear space; use a support if your balance is shaky.

exercises.name: Goblet Bulgarian Split Squat (Dumbbell)
setup: Rest your rear foot on a bench behind you and hold a dumbbell at your chest.
Step forward so your front shin can stay near vertical.
steps: Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Pause.
Drive through the front heel to stand.
mistakes: Front foot too close to the bench.
exercises.note: Place the bench so it can't slide, hold the dumbbell firmly, and use a weight that doesn't pull you off balance.

exercises.name: Goblet Forward Lunge (Dumbbell)
setup: Hold a dumbbell at your chest.
Stand tall with feet hip width.
steps: Step forward and lower until both knees are at about 90°.
Push through the front foot to step back.
Alternate legs or finish one side first.
mistakes: Short steps that push the knee past the toes.
exercises.note: Hold the dumbbell firmly at your chest and clear the space in front of you.

exercises.name: Goblet Split Squat (Dumbbell)
setup: Hold a dumbbell at your chest and take a staggered stance with both feet flat.
Back heel lifted.
steps: Lower straight down until the back knee almost touches the floor.
Pause.
Push straight up through the front foot.
mistakes: Rocking forward and back during the rep.
Back leg doing most of the work.
exercises.note: Hold the dumbbell firmly at your chest, and hold a support if your balance is shaky.

exercises.name: Halo (Dumbbell)
setup: Hold one dumbbell upright by the head with both hands in front of your chest.
Stand tall with ribs down.
steps: Circle the dumbbell around your head, keeping it close.
Pass it in front of your face and behind your neck.
Reverse direction after a few reps.
mistakes: Arching the lower back as the weight goes behind.
Letting the weight hit your head.
exercises.note: Start light and keep the weight close.

exercises.name: Hammer Preacher Curl (Dumbbell)
setup: Sit at a preacher bench with your upper arms flat on the pad.
Hold dumbbells with palms facing each other.
steps: Curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze.
Lower fully under control.
cues: Upper arms stay on the pad
mistakes: Lifting the elbows off the pad.
exercises.note: Don't drop all the way to a hard lockout with a heavy weight.

exercises.name: Incline Front Raise (Dumbbell)
setup: Sit back against an incline bench set to about 45°.
Dumbbells hang at your sides.
steps: Raise the dumbbells straight in front to eye level.
Lower slowly.
exercises.note: Keep the weights light and your back against the bench so your lower back doesn't arch.

exercises.name: Incline Row (Dumbbell)
setup: Lie chest down on an incline bench, a dumbbell in each hand.
Arms hang straight.
steps: Row the dumbbells toward your hips.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly.
exercises.note: Keep your chest on the pad and don't jerk the weights.

exercises.name: Leg Curl (Dumbbell)
setup: Lie face down on a bench and grip a dumbbell between your feet.
Hips stay on the pad.
steps: Curl the dumbbell toward your glutes.
Pause.
Lower slowly.
exercises.note: Use a light weight and squeeze the dumbbell firmly.

exercises.name: Lying One-Arm Rear Lateral Raise (Dumbbell)
setup: Lie on your side on a bench with a light dumbbell in the top hand.
Arm hangs straight down.
steps: Raise the dumbbell out to the side.
Hold.
Lower slowly.
exercises.note: Keep the weight light and your body still; stop if your shoulder pinches.

exercises.name: Neutral High Incline Bench Press (Dumbbell)
setup: Set the bench to a steep incline.
Hold dumbbells with palms facing each other.
steps: Press the dumbbells up and slightly together.
Lower to the sides of your chest.
exercises.note: Use a spotter or set the dumbbells down carefully; a steep bench loads the shoulders harder.

exercises.name: Overhead Squat (Dumbbell)
setup: Hold a dumbbell overhead with straight arms.
Feet shoulder width.
steps: Squat down, keeping the dumbbell above your mid-foot.
Stand.
exercises.note: Use a light weight and good shoulder mobility.

exercises.name: Push Press (Dumbbell)
setup: Hold dumbbells at the shoulders.
Feet shoulder width.
steps: Dip slightly at the knees.
Drive up and press overhead.
Lower the dumbbells.
exercises.note: Use a weight you can press overhead safely, and clear the space around you in case you drop a dumbbell.

exercises.name: Rear Delt Fly (Dumbbell)
setup: Hinge forward with a flat back and dumbbells hanging.
Slight bend in the elbows.
steps: Raise the dumbbells out to the sides.
Squeeze.
Lower slowly.
exercises.note: Keep the weights light and your back flat; the rear shoulders strain easily.

exercises.name: Rear Lunge (Dumbbell)
setup: Hold dumbbells at your sides.
Stand tall.
steps: Step back and lower the back knee.
Push through the front heel to return.
exercises.note: Hold the dumbbells at your sides and clear the space behind you before stepping back.

exercises.name: Row Bilateral (Dumbbell)
setup: Hinge forward holding dumbbells.
Flat back.
steps: Row both dumbbells to your hips.
Squeeze.
Lower slowly.
exercises.note: Keep your back flat and set the dumbbells down by bending your knees.

exercises.name: Row Unilateral (Dumbbell)
setup: Place one hand and knee on a bench, a dumbbell in the other hand.
Flat back.
steps: Row the dumbbell to your hip.
Squeeze.
Lower slowly.
exercises.note: Place your hand and knee firmly on the bench and keep your back flat.

exercises.name: Russian Twist (Dumbbell)
setup: Sit with knees bent and lean back slightly.
Hold a dumbbell at your chest.
steps: Rotate the torso to one side.
Rotate to the other side.
exercises.note: Keep the load light if your lower back is sensitive.

exercises.name: Seated Full Lateral Raise (Dumbbell)
setup: Sit upright on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing in.
Keep your back against the pad if there is one and your feet flat.
steps: Raise both dumbbells out to the sides up to shoulder height, elbows slightly bent.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly to your sides.
mistakes: Swinging your torso to get the weights up.
Using dumbbells that make the reps sloppy.
exercises.note: Keep the weights light enough to control, and stop if the top of your shoulder pinches.

exercises.name: Seated Rear Delt Fly (Dumbbell)
setup: Sit at the end of a bench and lean your chest forward over your thighs, holding a dumbbell in each hand under your knees.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows and a flat back.
steps: Raise the dumbbells out to the sides until your arms are about parallel to the floor.
Squeeze your rear shoulders at the top.
Lower slowly.
mistakes: Swinging the weights up with momentum.
exercises.note: Use light weights, since the rear shoulders are small and tire fast.

exercises.name: Seated Shrug (Dumbbell)
setup: Sit upright on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing in.
Keep your chest tall and your arms straight.
steps: Shrug your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Hold for a second at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms hang long.
mistakes: Bending your elbows to help lift.
exercises.note: Choose a weight you can hold on to for the full set, and put the dumbbells down by bending forward carefully.

exercises.name: Single Arm Chest Press (Dumbbell)
setup: Lie on a flat bench with one dumbbell.
Other arm out for balance.
steps: Press the dumbbell up.
Lower slowly.
exercises.note: Use a spotter for heavy sets, and keep the dumbbell over your chest, not your face.

exercises.name: Single Arm Clean And Press (Dumbbell)
setup: Place a dumbbell on the floor between your feet.
Hinge down with a flat back and grip it with one hand.
steps: Pull the dumbbell up to your shoulder, keeping it close to your body.
Rotate your elbow under it and catch it at the shoulder.
Press it overhead to lockout and lower it back down in the same path.
mistakes: Swinging the dumbbell away from your body.
exercises.note: Use a lighter dumbbell while you learn the path, and clear the space around you in case you drop it.

exercises.name: Single Arm Neutral Overhead Press (Dumbbell)
setup: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart, holding a dumbbell at your shoulder with your palm facing in.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
steps: Press the dumbbell straight up until your arm is locked out.
Pause at the top.
Lower it slowly back to your shoulder.
mistakes: Leaning to the side to finish the press.
exercises.note: Use a weight you can press without leaning, and stop if your shoulder pinches.

exercises.name: Single Arm Upright Row (Dumbbell)
setup: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in one hand in front of your thighs.
Keep your core braced.
steps: Pull your elbow up and out to the side, keeping the dumbbell close to your body.
Stop when your elbow reaches about shoulder height.
Lower slowly.
mistakes: Shrugging your shoulder up to your ear.
exercises.note: Keep the weight moderate and the elbow at or below shoulder height to protect your shoulder.

exercises.name: Single Leg Hip Thrust (Dumbbell)
setup: Sit with your upper back against a bench and a dumbbell resting on your hips.
Plant one foot flat and lift the other leg off the floor.
steps: Drive through the heel of the planted foot to lift your hips until your body is straight from shoulders to knee.
Squeeze the glute at the top.
Lower slowly.
mistakes: Letting your hips rotate toward the lifted leg.
exercises.note: Roll the dumbbell into position carefully and do all reps on the weaker side first.

exercises.name: Situp (Dumbbell)
setup: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat.
Hold a light dumbbell against your chest.
steps: Curl your torso up until you are sitting tall.
Pause.
Lower slowly one segment at a time.
exercises.note: Keep the dumbbell light, and tuck your feet under something stable if they lift.

exercises.name: Skullcrusher (Dumbbell)
setup: Lie on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand above your chest, palms facing each other.
Plant your feet flat on the floor.
steps: Bend your elbows to lower the dumbbells toward the sides of your head.
Stop when you feel a stretch in the back of your arms.
Extend your elbows back to the start.
exercises.note: Lower the dumbbells carefully beside your head, not onto your face, and use a spotter for heavy sets.

exercises.name: Spinal Jefferson Curl (Dumbbell)
setup: Stand tall holding a very light dumbbell at your chest.
Feet hip width apart, soft knees.
steps: Tuck your chin and slowly curl your spine down one segment at a time.
Go only as far as you can control.
Roll back up slowly to standing.
cues: Slow, one segment at a time
exercises.note: Use a very light weight, and stop immediately if you feel pain in your back.

exercises.name: Standing Single Arm Hammer Curl (Dumbbell)
setup: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in one hand at your side, palm facing your thigh.
Keep your elbow close to your ribs.
steps: Curl the dumbbell up with your palm still facing in and your thumb leading toward your shoulder.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly.
exercises.note: Keep the elbow pinned and don't swing; stop if your elbow aches.

exercises.name: Suitcase Carry (Dumbbell)
setup: Hold a heavy dumbbell in one hand at your side.
Stand tall with your ribs stacked over your hips.
steps: Walk forward with steady steps without leaning toward the weight.
Keep your shoulders level.
Switch hands and repeat.
exercises.note: Clear the path first and set the dumbbell down by bending your knees, not by rounding your back.

exercises.name: Superman (Dumbbell)
setup: Lie face down on a mat with your arms stretched overhead, holding a very light dumbbell.
Keep your forehead down and your neck neutral.
steps: Lift your arms, chest and legs slightly off the floor at the same time.
Hold for a second.
Lower slowly.
mistakes: Lifting your head and straining your neck.
exercises.note: Use a very light weight and keep the lift small; stop if your lower back pinches.

exercises.name: Thruster (Dumbbell)
setup: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your shoulders.
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
steps: Squat down until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
Drive up through your feet and press the dumbbells overhead in one fluid motion.
Lower the dumbbells to your shoulders as you return to the squat.
mistakes: Letting your heels lift in the squat.
Pressing before your legs finish driving.
exercises.note: Use dumbbells light enough to keep your form tight, and clear the space around you in case you drop one.

exercises.name: Tibialis Raise (Dumbbell)
setup: Sit on a bench with your heels on the floor and a light dumbbell held between your feet or on top of your forefoot.
Keep your knees bent.
steps: Lift your toes up toward your shins.
Hold for a second.
Lower slowly.
mistakes: Using a weight that is too heavy.
exercises.note: Keep the weight light and stop if the front of your shin hurts.

exercises.name: Windmill (Dumbbell)
setup: Hold a light dumbbell overhead in one hand with a locked elbow, feet wider than your shoulders.
Turn your back foot out slightly and keep your eyes on the weight.
steps: Push your hips out to the side of the weight arm and hinge forward.
Lower your free hand down your front leg toward the floor.
Reverse the movement to stand back up, keeping the dumbbell overhead.
mistakes: Rounding your back as you hinge.
exercises.note: Start with a very light dumbbell, and keep your eyes on the weight so your arm stays stacked over your shoulder.

exercises.name: Wrist Extension (Dumbbell)
setup: Sit with your forearm resting on your thigh, palm down, wrist just past the knee.
Hold a very light dumbbell.
steps: Lift the back of your hand up by extending your wrist.
Hold for a second at the top.
Lower slowly.
exercises.note: Use a very light weight, and stop if you feel pain on the outside of your elbow.

exercises.name: Eccentric Calf Lowers
exercises.equipment: Step or low platform, no equipment
setup: Stand with the balls of your feet on the edge of a step and your heels hanging off.
Hold a rail or wall for balance.
steps: Rise up onto your toes on both feet.
Shift your weight to one foot and lower over about three seconds to a full stretch.
Return to the top with both feet and repeat.
mistakes: Rolling to the outside of the foot.
exercises.note: Hold a support and build up gradually, since slow lowering can leave your calves very sore.

exercises.name: Elbow Side Plank
setup: Lie on your side with your elbow directly under your shoulder and your legs stacked.
Rest your top hand on your hip.
steps: Lift your hips up until your body forms a straight line.
Hold the position while breathing steadily.
Lower slowly.
exercises.note: Stop if you feel pain in your shoulder, and drop to your knees if you can't hold a straight line.

exercises.name: Bar Skullcrusher (EZ Bar)
setup: Lie on a flat bench and hold the EZ bar above your chest with an overhand grip.
Keep your feet planted and your upper arms vertical.
steps: Bend your elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead.
Pause just above your forehead.
Extend your elbows to return.
mistakes: Bouncing the bar off your forehead.
exercises.note: Use a spotter or a lighter weight than your press, since a missed rep lands near your face.

exercises.name: Fire Hydrants
setup: Start on your hands and knees with your hands under your shoulders and knees under your hips.
Keep your back flat.
steps: Lift one knee out to the side, keeping the knee bent at 90°.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat on the same side before switching.
mistakes: Rotating your hips as you lift.

exercises.name: Floor Press (Dumbbell)
setup: Lie on your back on the floor with your knees bent and a dumbbell in each hand.
Hold the dumbbells over your chest with your palms facing each other.
steps: Lower the dumbbells until your upper arms lightly touch the floor.
Pause for a second without relaxing.
Press the dumbbells back up over your chest.
mistakes: Bouncing your arms off the floor.
exercises.note: Use a pair of dumbbells you can control, and bring them down beside you carefully when you finish.

exercises.name: Forward Lunge
setup: Stand tall with your feet hip width apart and your hands on your hips.
Keep your chest up.
steps: Step forward and lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front shin about vertical.
Push through your front heel to step back to the start.
mistakes: Taking steps that are too short.
Letting your front knee cave in.
exercises.note: Hold a support if you need balance, and use a mat under the back knee.

exercises.name: Freestyle Swim
setup: Float face down with your arms stretched forward.
Keep your body long and your head in a neutral position.
steps: Alternate long arm strokes, pulling each hand under your body.
Flutter kick from the hips.
Turn your head to breathe to the side every two or three strokes.
mistakes: Crossing your hands over the midline.
exercises.note: Swim only where you can do so safely, ideally with a lifeguard on duty or someone nearby.

exercises.name: Frog Rock-Backs
setup: Start on your hands and knees with your knees wide and your toes turned out.
Keep your back flat.
steps: Rock your hips back toward your heels.
Feel the stretch in your inner thighs.
Rock forward again to the start.
exercises.note: Move gently, and stop if you feel a pinch in your hips or groin.

exercises.name: Front Plank on Elbows
setup: Rest on your forearms with your elbows directly under your shoulders and your toes on the floor.
Make a straight line from your head to your heels.
steps: Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs.
Hold the position without letting your hips drop.
Breathe steadily for the whole hold.
mistakes: Raising your hips into a pike.
exercises.note: Stop the set when your hips start to sag, and drop to your knees if your lower back aches.

exercises.name: Front Raise And Pullover (Dumbbell)
setup: Lie on a flat bench holding one dumbbell with both hands above your chest.
Plant your feet flat and brace your core.
steps: Lift the dumbbell straight up to above your eyes, then lower it behind your head with soft elbows.
Pause when you feel a stretch.
Pull it back over your chest.
mistakes: Arching your lower back as the weight goes back.
Dropping the weight behind your head.
Using a dumbbell that is too heavy.
exercises.note: Hold the dumbbell firmly with both hands, use a light weight, and stop if you feel a pinch in your shoulder.

exercises.name: Front Squat (Barbell)
setup: Rest the bar on your front shoulders with your fingertips under the bar and elbows pointing forward.
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
steps: Brace your core and sit down between your hips until your thighs are at least parallel.
Keep your elbows high.
Drive up through your whole foot to stand.
mistakes: Letting your elbows drop so the bar rolls forward.
exercises.note: Set the rack safeties just below your bottom position, and learn the rack position with a light bar before adding weight.

exercises.name: Front-Foot-Elevated Split Squat (Dumbbell)
setup: Stand in a split stance with your front foot on a small plate or step and your back foot behind you, holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Keep your torso upright.
steps: Lower your back knee toward the floor, keeping your front heel heavy.
Pause lightly.
Drive up through your front heel to stand.
mistakes: Letting your front knee cave in.
exercises.note: Use a stable plate or step and dumbbells you can hold safely, and hold a support if you need balance.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat Prying Hold (Kettlebell)
setup: Hold one kettlebell by the horns at your chest and stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Keep your elbows pointing down.
steps: Squat down until your elbows brush the insides of your knees.
At the bottom, gently push your knees out with your elbows and rock side to side.
Stand up through your whole foot.
mistakes: Rounding your back at the bottom.
Forcing the knees out with a lot of load.
exercises.note: Use a light kettlebell and move within your hip range; stop if you feel a pinch in your hip.

exercises.name: Good Mornings
setup: Set the bar on your upper back and stand with your feet hip width apart.
Keep your chest up and your knees soft.
steps: Push your hips back and hinge forward with a flat back until your torso is near parallel.
Pause when you feel a hamstring stretch.
Squeeze your glutes to stand tall.
exercises.note: Start with an empty bar, set the rack safeties, and stop the lowering if your back begins to round.

exercises.name: Half-Kneeling Hip Flexor Rock
setup: Kneel on a mat in a half-kneeling lunge with one foot forward and the other knee on the floor.
Keep your torso upright.
steps: Tuck your pelvis under by squeezing your back glute.
Rock your hips forward until you feel a stretch at the front of the hip.
Rock back slightly and repeat.
exercises.note: Pad your knee on a mat, and keep the rock gentle if your hip or knee feels pinched.

exercises.name: Hammer Strength High Row (Machine)
setup: Adjust the seat so you can reach the handles with your chest against the pad.
Grip the handles with your arms straight.
steps: Pull the handles back, driving your elbows toward your back pockets.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly to the start.
mistakes: Letting the stack crash at the end.
exercises.note: Set the seat so your arms stay in line with the handles, and pick a weight you can pull without leaning away from the pad.

exercises.name: Hammer Strength Iso-Lateral Row (Machine)
setup: Sit with your chest against the pad and the seat set so the handles are at mid-chest height.
Grip the handles and keep your back flat.
steps: Row both handles toward your torso.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly, one or both arms.
mistakes: Letting your shoulders round forward at the start.
exercises.note: Set the weight so you can control the return, and keep your back against the pad.

exercises.name: Hamstring Curl (Dumbbell)
setup: Lie face down on a bench and grip a dumbbell between your feet.
Keep your hips pressed into the pad.
steps: Curl the dumbbell toward your glutes.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly until your legs are nearly straight.
mistakes: Lifting your hips off the bench.
exercises.note: Squeeze the dumbbell firmly between your feet so it can't slip, and use a light weight.

exercises.name: Hand Plank
setup: Place your hands directly under your shoulders with your feet hip width apart and your legs straight.
Make a straight line from your head to your heels.
steps: Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs.
Hold the position without letting your hips drop.
Breathe steadily.
mistakes: Raising your hips into a pike.
exercises.note: Stop the set when your hips begin to sag, and drop to your knees if your lower back aches.

exercises.name: Hang Clean (Barbell)
setup: Stand with feet hip width apart and hold the bar at mid-thigh with an overhand grip just outside your hips.
Keep your chest up and your shoulders over the bar.
steps: Lower the bar to just above your knees by hinging your hips back.
Extend your hips explosively and shrug.
Pull your elbows high and catch the bar on your front shoulders in a quarter squat.
mistakes: Pulling with your arms before your hips extend.
Letting the bar swing out in front.
exercises.note: Learn this with a coach and a light bar, and use bumper plates on a platform so a missed lift can be dropped safely.

exercises.name: Hang Power Clean (Barbell)
setup: Stand with feet hip width apart holding the bar at mid-thigh with an overhand grip.
Keep your back flat and your chest up.
steps: Hinge to just above your knees.
Jump and shrug, extending your hips fully.
Pull yourself under the bar and catch it on your front shoulders in a partial squat.
exercises.note: Learn this with a coach, and use bumper plates on a platform so you can drop the bar safely.

exercises.name: Hang Snatch (Barbell)
setup: Take a wide snatch grip and stand with feet hip width apart, the bar at mid-thigh.
Keep your back flat and your chest up.
steps: Hinge to just above your knees.
Jump and shrug while pulling your elbows high.
Pull yourself under the bar and catch it overhead in a partial squat.
mistakes: Letting the bar swing away from your body.
Pulling with your arms before your hips extend.
exercises.note: This is a technical lift; learn it with a coach and bumper plates on a platform.

exercises.name: Heel and Toe Walks
setup: Stand tall with your arms relaxed at your sides.
Pick a safe, flat stretch of ground.
steps: Walk forward on your heels with your toes pulled up.
Then walk on your toes with your heels high.
Alternate between the two for a set distance.
cues: Toes up on the heel walk
Heels high on the toe walk
exercises.note: Do this on a non-slip surface and stop if your shins or calves cramp.

exercises.name: Heel Elevated Dumbbell Front Squat (Dumbbell)
setup: Stand with your heels raised on small plates and hold a dumbbell in each hand at your shoulders.
Keep your elbows pointing forward.
steps: Squat down until your thighs are at least parallel.
Keep your chest tall and your heels on the plates.
Drive up through your whole foot to stand.
mistakes: Letting your heels slide off the plates.
exercises.note: Use flat, stable plates, and drop the dumbbells to your sides if you lose balance.

exercises.name: Hiking
setup: Wear supportive footwear with good grip.
Carry water and a plan for the route.
steps: Walk at a steady pace on the trail or incline.
Shorten your stride on climbs and keep your chest up.
Let your arms swing naturally and take it at a pace you can maintain.
mistakes: Setting off too fast to keep up.
exercises.note: Wear good shoes, bring water, and tell someone your route when you hike outdoors.

exercises.name: Hill Climb Repeats (Cardio)
setup: Warm up with five minutes of easy movement.
Choose a hill or incline you can climb safely.
steps: Run or walk up briskly for the planned time.
Walk or jog down slowly to recover.
Repeat for the planned number of rounds.
exercises.note: Warm up first and stop if you feel sharp pain in your calves or Achilles; take the downhill slowly.

exercises.name: Hip Circles
setup: Stand tall with your feet hip width apart and your hands on your hips.
Keep your knees soft.
steps: Draw slow circles with your hips, as if tracing the inside of a barrel.
Make the circles as large as is comfortable.
Reverse the direction after several reps.
mistakes: Moving your shoulders instead of the hips.
exercises.note: Keep the range comfortable and stop if you feel a pinch in your hip.

exercises.name: Hip Hinge Drill
setup: Stand with your feet hip width apart and your hands on your hips.
Keep your knees soft.
steps: Push your hips back as far as they go while keeping your back flat.
Feel the stretch in your hamstrings.
Squeeze your glutes to bring your hips forward to stand.
exercises.note: Stop the hinge when your back starts to round.

exercises.name: Hip Hinge Speed Romanian Deadlift (Dumbbell)
setup: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs, feet hip width apart.
Keep your chest up and your knees soft.
steps: Push your hips back quickly and lower the dumbbells to mid-shin with a flat back.
Pause for a moment at the bottom.
Drive your hips forward fast to stand tall.
mistakes: Rounding your back at the bottom.
exercises.note: Use lighter dumbbells than a slow RDL, and keep your back flat; stop if your lower back tires.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Flyes With A Twist (Dumbbell)
setup: Lie back on a 30° incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand above your chest, palms facing each other.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
steps: Lower the dumbbells out to the sides in a wide arc until you feel a stretch.
As you bring them back up, rotate your palms to face each other with a small twist at the top.
Squeeze your chest at the top.
cues: Squeeze and twist at the top
mistakes: Bending your elbows so it becomes a press.
Lowering too far and straining the shoulders.
exercises.note: Use light dumbbells and bring them to your thighs carefully when you finish; stop if your shoulders pinch.

exercises.name: Incline Plyo Push-Up
setup: Place your hands on a stable raised surface slightly wider than your shoulders.
Make a straight line from your head to your heels.
steps: Lower your chest toward the surface.
Push explosively so your hands leave the surface briefly.
Land softly with bent elbows and go straight into the next rep.
mistakes: Doing too many reps once you tire.
exercises.note: Start with a low surface and a few reps; stop if your wrists or shoulders feel sore, and keep the bench from sliding.

exercises.name: Incline Push-Up Reverse Grip
setup: Place your hands on a stable raised surface with your palms facing back toward your feet, a little wider than shoulder width.
Make a straight line from head to heels.
steps: Lower your chest toward the surface with your elbows close to your sides.
Pause.
Push back up to straight arms.
mistakes: Forcing your wrists past a comfortable angle.
exercises.note: Stop if your wrists or elbows hurt, and go back to a normal grip.

exercises.name: Incline Push-Up Wide
setup: Place your hands on a stable raised surface wider than your shoulders.
Make a straight line from head to heels.
steps: Lower your chest toward the surface with your elbows angled out.
Pause.
Push back up to straight arms.
exercises.note: Make sure the bench can't slide, and keep the width comfortable for your shoulders.

exercises.name: Indoor Cycling (Spin Bike)
setup: Set the seat so your knee is slightly bent at the bottom of the pedal stroke and the handlebars at a comfortable reach.
Clip in or strap your feet securely.
steps: Warm up at an easy pace for five minutes.
Ride at the planned effort, adjusting the resistance dial.
Cool down for several minutes of easy spinning.
exercises.note: Make sure your feet are secure in the pedals, and don't stop pedalling abruptly as the flywheel keeps spinning.

exercises.name: JM Press (Barbell)
setup: Lie on a bench and unrack the bar with a grip just inside shoulder width.
Bring the bar over your chest.
steps: Lower the bar toward your upper chest/chin line while your elbows travel forward.
Stop when your forearms reach about 45° to the floor.
Press the bar back up to lockout.
mistakes: Lowering the bar all the way to your chest.
exercises.note: Use a spotter and a lighter weight than your bench press, since the bar travels near your face.

exercises.name: Jump Squats
setup: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and your arms ready to swing.
Keep your chest up.
steps: Squat down with your hips back.
Jump up explosively, extending your hips fully.
Land softly with bent knees and go into the next rep.
mistakes: Knees caving inward on the landing.
Landing on your toes with your heels up.
exercises.note: Warm up first and land on a forgiving surface; stop if your knees or ankles feel sore.

exercises.name: Jumping Jack
setup: Stand tall with your feet together and your arms at your sides.
Keep your knees soft.
steps: Jump your feet out wide while raising your arms overhead.
Jump your feet back together while lowering your arms.
Keep a steady rhythm.
mistakes: Rushing so the reps get sloppy.
exercises.note: Land softly on a non-slip surface, and use low-impact steps instead if your knees or ankles are sore.

exercises.name: Alternating Curtsy Lunge (Kettlebell)
setup: Hold a kettlebell by the horns at your chest.
Stand tall with your feet hip width apart.
steps: Step one leg behind and across the other, as if curtsying, and lower your back knee.
Push off the front foot to stand.
Switch sides.
mistakes: Letting the front knee cave in.
Stepping so far across that you lose balance.
exercises.note: Hold the kettlebell firmly at your chest, and clear the space around you.

exercises.name: Assisted Bulgarian Split Squat (Kettlebell)
setup: Hold a kettlebell at your chest and rest your rear foot on a bench behind you.
Hold a support with your free hand if you need it.
steps: Lower your back knee toward the floor while your front heel stays heavy.
Pause lightly.
Drive through your front heel to stand.
exercises.note: Place the bench against a wall so it can't slide, and keep the kettlebell light until your balance is steady.

exercises.name: Bench Press (Kettlebell)
setup: Lie on a flat bench with a kettlebell in each hand, held by the handle with the bell resting on your forearm.
Plant your feet on the floor.
steps: Lower the kettlebells to the sides of your chest.
Press them back up to straight arms.
Keep the bells stacked on your forearms.
mistakes: Letting the bells flop back on your wrists.
exercises.note: Get the kettlebells into position carefully and use a lighter weight than dumbbells; bring them down beside you when you finish.

exercises.name: Calf Raise (Kettlebell)
setup: Hold a kettlebell in one hand at your side and stand with the balls of your feet on a step.
Hold a support with your other hand.
steps: Rise up onto your toes as high as you can.
Hold for a second at the top.
Lower slowly into a full calf stretch.
mistakes: Rolling to the outside of your foot.
exercises.note: Hold a support for balance and use a stable step.

exercises.name: Clean & Press (Double) (Kettlebell)
setup: Place two kettlebells on the floor in front of you, feet hip width apart.
Hinge down and grip the handles.
steps: Swing the kettlebells back, then extend your hips to bring them to your shoulders in the rack position.
Brace and press both overhead to lockout.
Lower to the rack and swing back down in a controlled way.
mistakes: Letting the kettlebells bang your forearms.
exercises.note: Learn the single kettlebell clean first, use a lighter weight, and clear the area.

exercises.name: Curl (Kettlebell)
setup: Hold a kettlebell by the handle at your side with your palm facing forward.
Stand tall with your elbow pinned to your ribs.
steps: Curl the kettlebell toward your shoulder without moving your elbow.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly until your arm is straight.
mistakes: Swinging your body to start the rep.
Letting the bell bend your wrist.
exercises.note: Keep the elbow pinned and the bell close to your forearm; stop if your wrist bends back under the weight.

exercises.name: Farmers Carry (Kettlebell)
setup: Pick up a heavy kettlebell in each hand and stand tall.
Keep your shoulders back and down.
steps: Walk forward with short, quick steps for the distance or time.
Keep your ribs stacked over your hips.
Set the kettlebells down by bending your knees.
mistakes: Letting the bells swing into your legs.
Dropping the weights from standing height.
exercises.note: Clear the path first and bend your knees to set the weights down, not your back.

exercises.name: Front Raise (Kettlebell)
setup: Hold a kettlebell by its horns or handle in front of your thighs.
Stand tall with a slight lean back.
steps: Raise the kettlebell straight in front of you to eye level.
Pause.
Lower slowly.
exercises.note: Use a light kettlebell and keep your core braced.

exercises.name: Goblet Curl (Kettlebell)
setup: Hold a kettlebell by the horns at your chest, elbows pointing down.
Stand tall with your feet hip width apart.
steps: Curl the kettlebell up toward your chin by bending your elbows, keeping it close.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly.
exercises.note: Hold the horns firmly so the bell can't swing into your face.

exercises.name: Gorilla Row (Kettlebell)
setup: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder width and two kettlebells on the floor between your feet.
Hinge down with a flat back and grip the handles.
steps: Row one kettlebell to your hip while the other stays on the floor.
Lower it under control.
Row the other side, alternating.
mistakes: Standing up taller as you row.
Letting the bell swing into your legs.
exercises.note: Brace your core and keep your back flat; stop if your lower back tires.

exercises.name: Halo (Kettlebell)
setup: Hold a kettlebell upside down by the horns at your chest.
Stand tall with your ribs down.
steps: Circle the kettlebell around your head, keeping it close.
Pass it behind your neck and in front of your face.
Reverse direction after a few reps.
mistakes: Arching your lower back as the weight passes behind.
Letting the bell hit your head.
exercises.note: Use a light kettlebell and hold the horns firmly so the bell can't drop on your head.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust (Kettlebell)
setup: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and a kettlebell on your hips.
Plant your feet flat, hip width apart.
steps: Drive through your heels to lift your hips until your body is straight.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly.
exercises.note: Hold the kettlebell steady with both hands, and place a pad under it if it presses on your hips.

exercises.name: Incline Bench Press (Kettlebell)
setup: Lie back on a 30° incline bench holding a kettlebell in each hand with the bells resting on your forearms.
Plant your feet on the floor.
steps: Lower the kettlebells to the sides of your chest.
Press them back up.
Keep your wrists straight.
exercises.note: Get the kettlebells into position carefully, use a lighter weight, and bring them down beside you when you finish.

exercises.name: Push Press (Kettlebell)
setup: Rack a kettlebell at your shoulder, with your elbow tucked and wrist straight.
Stand with your feet hip width apart.
steps: Dip slightly at the knees.
Drive up and press the kettlebell overhead to lockout.
Lower it to the rack position.
mistakes: Letting the bell crash onto your forearm.
exercises.note: Use a lighter kettlebell while you learn the dip, and clear the space around you.

exercises.name: Renegade Rows (Kettlebell)
setup: Place two kettlebells on the floor shoulder width apart and set up in a push-up position with your hands on the handles.
Spread your feet wider for balance.
steps: Row one kettlebell to your hip while balancing on the other.
Lower it under control.
Row the other side.
mistakes: Letting your hips twist as you row.
Letting the bell tip as you push on it.
exercises.note: Use stable, flat-based kettlebells and a lighter weight until you can resist twisting; drop to your knees if needed.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift (Kettlebell)
setup: Hold a kettlebell in both hands in front of your thighs.
Stand with feet hip width apart and soften your knees.
steps: Push your hips back and lower the kettlebell along your legs with a flat back.
Pause at a hamstring stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
exercises.note: Stop lowering when your back starts to round, and set the bell down by bending your knees.

exercises.name: Row (Kettlebell)
setup: Hold a kettlebell in each hand and hinge forward with a flat back.
Let your arms hang below your chest.
steps: Row both kettlebells to your ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly.
exercises.note: Keep your back flat, and set the kettlebells down by bending your knees.

exercises.name: Row (Single) (Kettlebell)
setup: Hold a kettlebell in one hand and hinge forward with a flat back.
Rest your other hand on your thigh or a bench.
steps: Row the kettlebell to your hip.
Squeeze your shoulder blade.
Lower slowly.
exercises.note: Rest your free hand on something stable and keep your back flat.

exercises.name: Seated Overhead Press (Kettlebell)
setup: Sit with your back supported and rack a kettlebell at your shoulder, wrist straight.
Plant your feet on the floor.
steps: Press the kettlebell straight overhead to lockout.
Pause.
Lower it slowly to your shoulder.
mistakes: Letting the bell tip back on your wrist.
exercises.note: Use a lighter kettlebell than your dumbbell press, and clear the space around you.

exercises.name: Shrug (Kettlebell)
setup: Stand tall holding a kettlebell in each hand at your sides.
Keep your arms straight.
steps: Shrug your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Hold for a second.
Lower slowly.
exercises.note: Set the kettlebells down by bending your knees, not by rounding your back.

exercises.name: Single Arm Row (Kettlebell)
setup: Place one hand and the same-side knee on a bench and hold a kettlebell in the other hand.
Keep your back flat.
steps: Row the kettlebell to your hip.
Squeeze your shoulder blade.
Lower slowly.
exercises.note: Place the bench against a wall so it can't slide.

exercises.name: Spinal Jefferson Curl (Kettlebell)
setup: Stand holding a light kettlebell at your chest.
Feet hip width apart, soft knees.
steps: Tuck your chin and slowly curl your spine down one segment at a time.
Lower only as far as you can control.
Roll up slowly.
exercises.note: Use a very light weight and stop immediately if you feel pain in your back.

exercises.name: Suitcase Carry (Kettlebell)
setup: Hold a heavy kettlebell in one hand at your side.
Stand tall with your ribs over your hips.
steps: Walk forward without leaning toward the weight.
Keep your shoulders level.
Switch hands and repeat.
exercises.note: Clear the path and set the kettlebell down by bending your knees.

exercises.name: Sumo Deadlift (Kettlebell)
setup: Stand with your feet wide and toes turned out, holding a kettlebell between your legs by the handle.
Keep your chest up.
steps: Hinge and bend your knees to lower the kettlebell toward the floor with a flat back.
Drive through your heels to stand tall.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
exercises.note: Keep your back flat and set the kettlebell down by bending your knees.

exercises.name: Thruster (Kettlebell)
setup: Rack two kettlebells at your shoulders with your elbows tucked.
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
steps: Squat down until your thighs are parallel.
Drive up and press the kettlebells overhead in one motion.
Lower them to the racked position.
mistakes: Letting the bells crash onto your forearms.
exercises.note: Use lighter kettlebells than you would for presses, and clear the space around you.

exercises.name: Walking Lunges (Kettlebell)
setup: Hold a kettlebell in each hand at your sides or racked at your shoulders.
Stand tall with your feet hip width apart.
steps: Step forward and lower your back knee toward the floor.
Push off the front foot to bring the back foot through.
Alternate legs while walking.
mistakes: Letting the front knee cave in.
exercises.note: Use a clear path and kettlebells you can hold securely.

exercises.name: Windmill (Kettlebell)
setup: Hold a kettlebell overhead in one hand with a locked elbow, feet wider than your shoulders.
Turn your back foot out slightly and keep your eyes on the weight.
steps: Push your hips out to the side of the weight arm and hinge forward.
Lower your free hand down your front leg toward the floor.
Reverse the movement to stand, keeping the kettlebell overhead.
exercises.note: Start with a very light kettlebell and keep your eyes on the weight so your arm stays stacked.

exercises.name: Kickstand Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift (Dumbbell)
setup: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand, with one foot slightly behind you on its toes like a kickstand.
Soften your front knee.
steps: Hinge at the hips and lower the dumbbells along your front leg with a flat back.
Pause at a hamstring stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
mistakes: Putting your weight on the back foot.
exercises.note: Keep the weights moderate and stop lowering when your back begins to round.

exercises.name: Leaning Single Arm Lateral Raise (Dumbbell)
setup: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and a stable support in the other, leaning your body away from the support.
Keep your arm hanging at your side.
steps: Raise the dumbbell out to the side to shoulder height with your elbow leading.
Pause.
Lower slowly.
exercises.note: Hold the support firmly and keep the weight light.

exercises.name: Leg Swings (Front-to-Back)
setup: Stand tall holding a wall or rail with one hand.
Keep your standing knee soft.
steps: Swing your free leg forward and backward in a smooth arc.
Keep your torso upright.
Build the range slowly, then switch legs.
mistakes: Leaning your torso with each swing.
Arching your lower back on the back swing.
exercises.note: Keep the swing gentle at first and hold a support firmly; stop if you feel a pinch in your hip.

exercises.name: Lever Lateral Wide Pulldown (Machine)
setup: Sit with your thighs secured under the pads and grip the handles wide.
Lean back slightly with your chest up.
steps: Pull the handles down toward your upper chest, driving your elbows down.
Squeeze your lats.
Let the handles rise slowly.
mistakes: Letting the weight pull your arms up fast.
exercises.note: Set the seat and thigh pad so your hips stay planted, and release the handles slowly.

exercises.name: Loaded Wrist-Extensor Eccentric (Dumbbell)
setup: Sit with your forearm on your thigh, palm down, holding a very light dumbbell.
Let your wrist hang over your knee.
steps: Use your other hand to help lift the wrist up.
Then slowly lower the wrist over about four seconds on its own.
Reset and repeat.
exercises.note: Use a very light weight and stop if you feel pain on the outside of your elbow; tendons need a gradual build.

exercises.name: Loaded Wrist-Flexor Eccentric (Dumbbell)
setup: Sit with your forearm on your thigh, palm up, holding a very light dumbbell.
Let your wrist hang over your knee.
steps: Use your other hand to help curl the wrist up.
Then slowly lower the wrist over about four seconds on its own.
Reset and repeat.
exercises.note: Use a very light weight and stop if you feel pain on the inside of your elbow.

exercises.name: Long Treadmill Run
setup: Wear supportive shoes and clip the safety key to your clothing.
Start with a five-minute easy walk.
steps: Raise the speed gradually to a comfortable running pace.
Keep it steady for the planned time.
Slow to a walk to cool down.
mistakes: Starting too fast for the distance.
exercises.note: Clip the safety key to your clothing, and slow to a walk before stepping off.

exercises.name: Lunge Sprint
setup: Warm up thoroughly with some easy lunges and jogging.
Mark out a short running lane.
steps: Take a fast, long forward lunge and push off into the next.
Drive your arms and legs powerfully.
Keep the sprint short and rest between runs.
mistakes: Overstriding so the front knee goes far forward.
exercises.note: Warm up first, use a non-slip surface, and stop if you feel a pull in your hamstring or groin.

exercises.name: Lying Cambered Barbell Row (Barbell)
setup: Lie face down on a high bench with the bar on the floor beneath you, gripping it overhand.
Keep your chest on the pad.
steps: Row the bar up to the underside of the bench.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly.
mistakes: Lifting your chest off the bench.
exercises.note: Set the bench high enough that your arms can fully extend, and lower the bar carefully to the floor.

exercises.name: Lying One-Arm Lateral Raise (Dumbbell)
setup: Lie on your side on a bench with a light dumbbell in your top hand.
Let your arm hang in front of you.
steps: Raise the dumbbell out to the side up to shoulder height.
Pause.
Lower slowly.
exercises.note: Keep the weight light and hold the bench with your other hand.

exercises.name: 45 Degree Back Extension (Machine)
setup: Set the pad at hip height and tuck your ankles under the rollers.
Cross your arms over your chest.
steps: Lower your torso until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Raise your torso until your body is in a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
mistakes: Rounding your back at the bottom.
exercises.note: Stop at a straight body line rather than an arch, and add weight gradually.

exercises.name: Cable V Bar Push Downs (Machine)
setup: Stand close to the stack and grip the V-bar with your elbows pinned to your sides.
Lean forward slightly.
steps: Push the bar down until your arms are fully straight.
Squeeze.
Let the bar rise until your forearms are just past parallel.
mistakes: Letting the bar ride up to your face.
exercises.note: Keep your wrists straight and stop if your elbows ache.

exercises.name: Goblet Sissy Squat
setup: Stand holding a dumbbell at your chest, with your heels raised slightly and holding a support with your free hand.
Keep your torso upright.
steps: Lean your torso back slightly and bend your knees forward, letting your knees travel far over your toes.
Lower as far as you can control with your heels raised.
Press back up.
exercises.note: Hold a support, keep the weight light, and stop if you feel pain in your knees; this puts a lot of load on the knee.

exercises.name: Hip Abduction (Machine)
setup: Sit with your back against the pad and place your knees or outer thighs against the pads.
Set the starting width to a comfortable range.
steps: Push your legs out to the sides against the pads.
Pause at the end.
Return slowly.
mistakes: Setting the start width too wide.
exercises.note: Set the range so your hips aren't stretched uncomfortably at the start.

exercises.name: Hip Adduction (Machine)
setup: Sit with your back against the pad and place your inner knees or thighs against the pads.
Set the starting width to a comfortable range.
steps: Squeeze your legs together.
Pause.
Return slowly.
mistakes: Setting the start width too wide.
exercises.note: Set the range so your inner thighs aren't stretched sharply at the start, and let the weight back slowly.

exercises.name: Neutral Row (Machine)
setup: Sit with your chest on the pad and grip the neutral handles.
Keep your arms straight and shoulders down.
steps: Pull the handles toward your torso, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Pause.
Return slowly.
exercises.note: Set the seat so your arms are level with the handles, and release the handles slowly.

exercises.name: Plate Loaded Front Military Press (Machine)
setup: Adjust the seat so the handles are at shoulder height and sit with your back against the pad.
Grip the handles.
steps: Press the handles up until your arms are straight.
Pause.
Lower under control to shoulder height.
exercises.note: Use the safety stops, and don't shrug or arch to move heavier weight.

exercises.name: Plate Loaded Leg Extension (Machine)
setup: Sit with your back against the pad and the pad on your lower shins.
Align your knees with the pivot.
steps: Extend your legs until they are straight.
Squeeze your quads.
Lower slowly.
exercises.note: Adjust the pad above your ankles and stop if your knees hurt.

exercises.name: Plate Loaded T Bar Row (Machine)
setup: Stand on the platform and hinge forward, or lean your chest on the pad.
Grip the handles.
steps: Row the handles toward your torso.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly.
exercises.note: Keep your chest on the pad or your back flat, and lower the weight slowly.

exercises.name: Pulldown (Machine)
setup: Sit with your thighs secured under the pads and grip the handles.
Lean back slightly.
steps: Pull the handles down toward your upper chest.
Squeeze your lats.
Let the handles rise slowly.
mistakes: Letting the handles pull you up fast.
exercises.note: Release the handles slowly so you aren't pulled up.

exercises.name: Underhand Row (Machine)
setup: Sit with your chest on the pad and grip the handles with your palms up.
Keep your arms straight.
steps: Pull the handles toward your torso, keeping your elbows close.
Squeeze.
Return slowly.
exercises.note: Set the seat so the handles are level with your lower chest.

exercises.name: Man Maker (Dumbbell)
setup: Place two dumbbells on the floor and hold them in a push-up position.
Spread your feet wider for balance.
steps: Do a push-up.
Row one dumbbell, then the other.
Jump your feet in, stand and press the dumbbells overhead.
mistakes: Pressing with your lower back arched.
exercises.note: Use hex dumbbells that won't roll and a light weight; this is a hard conditioning move, so stop if your form breaks down.

exercises.name: MB Throw (Medicine Ball)
setup: Hold a medicine ball at your chest and stand with your feet shoulder width apart, facing a solid wall or a partner.
Keep your elbows under the ball.
steps: Drive the ball forward from your chest as hard as you can.
Catch the rebound with soft elbows.
Reset and repeat.
exercises.note: Throw only at a solid wall with clear space, and use a ball weight you can catch safely.

exercises.name: Muscle-up
setup: Hang from the bar or rings with a false grip or a regular grip.
Engage your shoulders.
steps: Pull explosively so your chest rises above the bar.
Transition your elbows over the bar.
Press out to the top, then lower under control.
exercises.note: This is an advanced move; build up with strict pull-ups and dips first.

exercises.name: Narrow Pulldown (Machine)
setup: Sit with your thighs secured and grip the narrow handle.
Lean back slightly.
steps: Pull the handle down to your upper chest.
Squeeze your lats.
Let the handle rise slowly.
mistakes: Letting the handle pull you up.
exercises.note: Release the handle slowly so you aren't pulled up.

exercises.name: Neck Curl
exercises.equipment: Floor or bench, optional light resistance
setup: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your head in neutral.
Place a hand on your forehead if using resistance.
steps: Tuck your chin and lift your head slightly off the floor.
Hold for a second.
Lower slowly.
exercises.note: Use only light resistance, and stop if you feel pain, tingling, or dizziness in your neck.

exercises.name: Neck Extension
setup: Lie face down with your forehead on a folded towel.
Place your hands by your sides.
steps: Gently lift your head a few centimetres off the towel.
Hold for a second.
Lower slowly.
mistakes: Lifting too high and arching the neck.
exercises.note: Keep the lift small, and stop if you feel pain, tingling, or dizziness in your neck.

exercises.name: Neutral-Grip Dumbbell Bench Press (Dumbbell)
setup: Lie on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand above your chest, palms facing each other.
Plant your feet flat.
steps: Lower the dumbbells to the sides of your chest, elbows about 45° from your body.
Pause.
Press back up.
exercises.note: Use a spotter for heavy sets, and set the dumbbells down on your thighs when you finish.

exercises.name: One Arm Dumbbell Bench Press (Dumbbell)
setup: Lie on a flat bench with one dumbbell above your chest and the other hand on your stomach or the bench.
Plant your feet flat.
steps: Lower the dumbbell to the side of your chest, elbow about 45° from your body.
Pause.
Press it back up without letting your torso rotate.
mistakes: Rotating your torso toward the weighted side.
exercises.note: Use a lighter weight than usual to start, and set the dumbbell down on your thigh when you finish.

exercises.name: One Leg Barbell Squat (Barbell)
setup: Set the bar on your upper back and stand in a staggered stance, with your rear foot resting on a bench or just behind you.
Brace your core.
steps: Squat down on the front leg while the back foot lightly assists.
Keep your torso upright.
Drive up through the front heel.
exercises.note: Set the rack safeties and start with an empty bar, since balance is limited with the bar on your back.

exercises.name: One-Arm Incline Lateral Raise (Dumbbell)
setup: Lie sideways on an incline bench with your chest on the pad and a light dumbbell in your hand.
Let your arm hang down.
steps: Raise the dumbbell out to the side to shoulder height.
Pause.
Lower slowly.
exercises.note: Keep the weight light, since the shoulder is held in a stretched position.

exercises.name: One-Arm Kettlebell Military Press To Side (Kettlebell)
setup: Rack a kettlebell at your shoulder with your elbow tucked.
Stand with feet hip width apart.
steps: Press the kettlebell overhead.
Lean your torso slightly away as you press so the arm stays vertical.
Lower to the rack position.
mistakes: Letting the bell tip back on your wrist.
exercises.note: Use a light kettlebell, and clear the space around you.

exercises.name: Open Book Rotation
setup: Lie on your side with your knees bent and stacked at 90°, and your arms straight out in front of you with palms together.
Keep your knees together.
steps: Rotate your top arm up and over your body toward the floor behind you.
Follow your hand with your eyes.
Return the arm slowly to the start.
mistakes: Forcing the arm to the floor.
exercises.note: Move slowly within a comfortable range, and stop if you feel a pinch in your shoulder or back.

exercises.name: Open Book Rotations
setup: Lie on your side with your knees bent and stacked, and your arms out in front of you with palms together.
Keep your knees pinned together.
steps: Open your top arm and rotate it toward the floor behind you.
Breathe out as you open.
Return slowly and repeat.
exercises.note: Move slowly within a comfortable range, and stop if you feel pinching in your shoulder.

exercises.name: Pallof Press (Cable Machine, Resistance Band)
exercises.equipment: Cable machine or resistance band, anchor
setup: Set the cable at chest height and stand side-on with the handle held at your chest.
Feet shoulder width apart, knees soft.
steps: Press the handle straight out in front of you until your arms are straight.
Resist the pull rotating your torso.
Bring it back to your chest.
mistakes: Letting your torso twist toward the cable.
exercises.note: Choose a weight that lets you resist rotation, and check the band or cable is anchored securely.

exercises.name: Parallel Bar Dips
setup: Hold yourself on the bars with straight arms and a slight forward lean.
Cross your legs behind you.
steps: Lower your body by bending your elbows until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
Pause.
Press back up to straight arms.
exercises.note: Don't lower past the point where your shoulders feel strained, and use an assisted version if you can't control the lowering.

exercises.name: Pause Squat
setup: Stand with feet shoulder width apart, arms in front.
Brace your core.
steps: Squat down to the bottom position.
Pause for two or three seconds without relaxing.
Drive up through your whole foot.
exercises.note: If you add a bar, set the rack safeties and use less weight than your normal squat.

exercises.name: Pendlay Row (Barbell)
setup: Stand over the bar with feet hip width apart and hinge until your torso is parallel to the floor.
Grip the bar overhand just outside your knees.
steps: Pull the bar explosively to your lower ribs.
Let it return to the floor each rep.
Reset your back flat and repeat.
exercises.note: Keep your back flat and brace your core on every rep; set the bar down rather than dropping it.

exercises.name: Pendulum Squat / V-Squat (Machine)
setup: Stand on the platform with your shoulders under the pads and your back against the support.
Release the safeties.
steps: Squat down along the machine's arc.
Pause at the bottom.
Drive up through your whole foot.
exercises.note: Make sure the safeties are set and the pads are adjusted to your height before loading.

exercises.name: Pike Push-Up/Handstand Push-Up
setup: Start in a pike position with your hips high and your hands on the floor shoulder width apart.
Walk your feet closer if needed.
steps: Bend your elbows to lower the top of your head toward the floor.
Pause.
Press back up to straight arms.
exercises.note: Use a mat under your head, and learn the pike push-up before trying handstand push-ups against a wall.

exercises.name: Pistol Squat
setup: Stand on one leg with the other leg extended in front.
Reach your arms forward for balance.
steps: Squat down on the standing leg while holding the other leg off the floor.
Pause at the bottom.
Stand back up.
exercises.note: Hold a support or use an assisted version first, and stop if your knee hurts.

exercises.name: Pistol Squat (Assisted)
setup: Hold a support such as a rail or suspension strap in front of you.
Stand on one leg with the other extended forward.
steps: Squat down on the standing leg using the support for balance.
Pause.
Stand back up with as little help as you need.
exercises.note: Make sure the support is secure, and stop if your knee hurts.

exercises.name: Forward Lunge (Plate)
setup: Hold a weight plate at your chest with both hands.
Stand tall with your feet hip width apart.
steps: Step forward and lower your back knee toward the floor.
Push through your front heel to stand.
Alternate legs.
mistakes: Letting the front knee cave in.
exercises.note: Grip the plate firmly at the edges, and use a lighter plate until your balance is steady.

exercises.name: Pinch (Plate)
setup: Pinch two smooth-sided plates together with one hand, fingers on one side and thumb on the other.
Stand tall with your arm at your side.
steps: Hold the plates for a set time or walk with them.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.
Set them down when your grip fails.
exercises.note: Hold them over a mat and set them down gently, so they can't drop on your feet.

exercises.name: Plyo Kettlebell Pushups (Kettlebell)
setup: Set two kettlebells on the floor shoulder width apart and grip the handles in a push-up position, or start with your hands on the floor between them.
Keep your body in a straight line.
steps: Lower your chest between the bells.
Push explosively so your hands leave the floor or the handles.
Land with both hands on the floor between the bells, elbows soft, and go into the next rep.
cues: Land on the floor, not the handles
mistakes: Landing on the handles, where a bell can roll or tip.
exercises.note: Never land on a kettlebell handle after a jump; use flat-based bells as fixed handles only if you stay in contact, and stop if your wrists or shoulders feel sore.

exercises.name: Pogo Hops
setup: Stand tall with your feet together and your arms at your sides.
Keep your knees nearly straight.
steps: Hop up using only your ankles and calves.
Land on the balls of your feet.
Hop again immediately.
exercises.note: Warm up first and use a forgiving surface; stop if your calves or Achilles hurt.

exercises.name: Power Clean - no overhead press (Barbell)
setup: Stand with feet hip width apart and the bar over your midfoot.
Grip just outside your knees, chest up and back flat.
steps: Pull the bar off the floor and keep it close.
Extend your hips explosively and shrug.
Pull yourself under the bar and catch it on your front shoulders, then stand.
mistakes: Pulling with your arms before your hips extend.
exercises.note: Learn this with a coach, and use bumper plates on a platform so a missed lift can be dropped safely.

exercises.name: Press Sit-Up (Barbell)
setup: Lie on your back with your knees bent, a light barbell held overhead with straight arms.
Tuck your feet under something stable if needed.
steps: Sit up while keeping the bar overhead.
Pause at the top, sitting tall.
Lower slowly back down.
exercises.note: Use a very light bar, and stop if you feel strain in your lower back or shoulders.

exercises.name: Prone Lateral Raises (Dumbbell)
setup: Lie face down on a bench or mat with a light dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging.
Keep your neck neutral.
steps: Raise the dumbbells out to the sides to shoulder height.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly.
exercises.note: Keep the weights light, since the rear shoulders are small and strain easily.

exercises.name: Prone Y-T Raises
setup: Lie face down with your arms overhead in a Y shape, forehead resting lightly on the floor.
Keep your legs straight.
steps: Lift your arms and chest slightly in the Y position.
Lower, then repeat in a T shape with arms out to the sides.
Continue alternating Y and T.
exercises.note: Keep the lift small and your neck neutral, and stop if you feel a pinch in your lower back.

exercises.name: Prying Goblet Squat (Kettlebell)
setup: Hold a kettlebell by the horns at your chest.
Stand with feet wide and toes turned out.
steps: Squat deep, pressing your elbows against your knees.
At the bottom, gently pry your knees out with your elbows.
Stand back up.
mistakes: Rounding your back at the bottom.
exercises.note: Use a light kettlebell and stay within your hip range; stop if you feel a pinch in your hip.

exercises.name: Push Jerk (Barbell)
setup: Rack the bar on your front shoulders with your elbows slightly in front.
Stand with feet hip width apart.
steps: Dip slightly.
Drive up explosively and push the bar overhead while dropping into a quarter squat to catch it.
Stand tall, then lower the bar to your shoulders.
mistakes: Pressing out instead of dropping under.
exercises.note: Learn this with a coach, and use bumper plates and a platform so you can drop a missed lift safely.

exercises.name: Quadruped Thoracic Rotation
setup: Start on your hands and knees with one hand behind your head.
Keep your hips back toward your heels.
steps: Rotate your upper back and bring your elbow toward the opposite elbow.
Then rotate open, reaching your elbow toward the ceiling.
Return slowly.
exercises.note: Move slowly within a comfortable range, and stop if you feel pinching in your back.

exercises.name: Reverse Hack Squat (Machine)
setup: Stand facing the pad with your chest against it and your feet low on the platform.
Release the safeties.
steps: Squat down with your knees tracking forward.
Pause.
Drive up through your whole foot.
exercises.note: Make sure the safeties are set and the pads adjusted before loading.

exercises.name: Reverse Hyperextension
setup: Lie face down with your hips at the edge of the pad and hold the handles.
Let your legs hang down.
steps: Lift your legs until they are in line with your body.
Squeeze your glutes.
Lower slowly.
exercises.note: Stop at a straight line rather than an arch, and keep the swing controlled.

exercises.name: Reverse Pec Deck (Machine)
setup: Sit facing the pad and adjust the handles to shoulder height.
Grip the handles with a slight elbow bend.
steps: Pull the handles back and out in an arc.
Squeeze your rear shoulders.
Return slowly.
exercises.note: Keep the weight light, and set the start position so your shoulders aren't stretched sharply.

exercises.name: Reverse-Grip Barbell Bench Press (Barbell)
setup: Lie on a flat bench and unrack the bar with an underhand grip shoulder width apart.
Plant your feet.
steps: Lower the bar to your lower chest.
Press up to lockout.
Keep your elbows close to your sides.
exercises.note: Use a spotter and a light weight; the underhand grip loads your wrists and shoulders differently.

exercises.name: RKC Plank
setup: Rest on your forearms with your elbows under your shoulders.
Squeeze your fists and brace your glutes.
steps: Squeeze your fists, glutes and abs as hard as you can.
Hold for a short, intense time.
Rest and repeat.
exercises.note: Keep holds short, and stop if your lower back aches.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift from Deficit (Barbell)
setup: Stand on a low platform with the bar in front of your thighs.
Soften your knees and keep your chest up.
steps: Push your hips back and lower the bar below the platform level with a flat back.
Pause at a hamstring stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
exercises.note: Brace your core and stop the lowering when your back begins to round; use light weight.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift Hamstring Sweeps
setup: Stand tall on one leg with the other foot hovering.
Reach your arms forward.
steps: Hinge forward and sweep your hands across the floor from side to side.
Return to standing.
Switch legs.
exercises.note: Hold a support if needed, and keep the reach within your balance.

exercises.name: Rowing Intervals (Machine)
setup: Sit on the seat with your feet strapped in and grip the handle.
Set the damper to a moderate level.
steps: Push through your legs, then lean back and pull the handle to your lower ribs.
Reverse the sequence on the return.
Alternate hard and easy efforts.
cues: Arms, then back, then legs on return
exercises.note: Warm up first and keep your back flat; stop if your lower back aches.

exercises.name: Rowing Sprint (Machine)
setup: Sit on the seat with your feet strapped in and grip the handle.
Set the damper to a moderate level.
steps: Take strong, fast strokes for a short sprint.
Drive with your legs first.
Rest completely between sprints.
exercises.note: Warm up fully before sprinting, and stop if you feel dizzy or lower back pain.

exercises.name: Running Cooldown
setup: Finish your run and slow to a gentle jog.
Keep your posture tall.
steps: Jog slowly for several minutes.
Slow to a walk.
Stretch gently afterwards.
exercises.note: Don't stop suddenly after hard running; keep walking until your breathing settles.

exercises.name: Running Intervals
setup: Warm up with five to ten minutes of easy jogging.
Choose a safe, flat route.
steps: Run hard for the work interval.
Jog or walk to recover.
Repeat for the planned rounds.
exercises.note: Warm up fully, wear good shoes, and stop if you feel sharp pain in your calves, shins or knees.

exercises.name: Scapular Pull-up
setup: Hang from the bar with a grip slightly wider than your shoulders and your arms straight.
Let your shoulders rise toward your ears in a passive hang.
steps: Pull your shoulder blades down and back without bending your elbows.
Lift your body a few centimetres.
Return slowly to the passive hang.
exercises.note: Step down from the bar carefully, and stop if your shoulders feel pinched.

exercises.name: Seal Row (Barbell)
setup: Lie face down on a high bench with the bar on the floor beneath you, gripping it overhand.
Keep your chest on the pad.
steps: Row the bar up until it touches the underside of the bench.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly.
mistakes: Lifting your chest off the pad.
exercises.note: Set the bench high enough that your arms fully extend, and lower the bar carefully to the floor.

exercises.name: Seated Ankle Circles
setup: Sit upright on a chair with one leg lifted off the floor.
Keep your knee still.
steps: Rotate your ankle in slow circles in one direction.
Then reverse the direction.
Switch legs.
exercises.note: Stay within a comfortable range, and stop if you feel sharp pain in your ankle.

exercises.name: Seated Barbell Military Press (Barbell)
exercises.equipment: Barbell, bench with back support, rack
setup: Sit upright on a bench with back support and unrack the bar at shoulder height.
Grip slightly wider than shoulder width.
steps: Press the bar straight up until your arms are locked out.
Pause.
Lower it to your upper chest or chin height.
exercises.note: Use rack safeties and a spotter for heavy sets, and don't arch to move more weight.

exercises.name: Seated Chin Tuck / Neck Retraction
setup: Sit tall in a chair with your eyes level.
Relax your shoulders.
steps: Gently draw your chin straight back, making a double chin.
Hold for a few seconds.
Release slowly.
exercises.note: Keep it gentle, and stop if you feel pain, tingling, or dizziness.

exercises.name: Seated Lateral Neck Flexion (Hold)
setup: Sit tall in a chair with your shoulders relaxed.
Rest one hand on your seat.
steps: Slowly tilt your ear toward your shoulder.
Hold the stretch for 20 to 30 seconds while breathing.
Return slowly and switch sides.
mistakes: Raising your shoulder to meet your ear.
exercises.note: Don't pull on your head; stop if you feel pain, tingling, or numbness.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl (Machine)
setup: Sit with your back against the pad and the pad above your heels.
Adjust the thigh pad so your legs are secured.
steps: Curl your heels down and back toward the floor.
Squeeze.
Return slowly until your legs are nearly straight.
exercises.note: Adjust the pad above your ankles and use a weight you can control on the return.

exercises.name: Seated Pelvic Tilt (Anterior / Posterior)
setup: Sit tall at the front of a chair with your feet flat.
Place your hands on your thighs.
steps: Roll your pelvis backward so your lower back rounds.
Then roll your pelvis forward so your lower back arches slightly.
Move slowly between the two.
exercises.note: Move gently, and stop if you feel pain in your lower back.

exercises.name: Seated Shoulder Rolls / Scapular Retraction
setup: Sit tall in a chair with your arms relaxed.
Keep your chin level.
steps: Roll your shoulders up, back, and down in slow circles.
Then squeeze your shoulder blades together for a second.
Release.

exercises.name: Seated Thoracic Extension (Chest Opener)
setup: Sit tall in a chair with your hands behind your head.
Keep your elbows wide.
steps: Open your chest and lean back over the chair top.
Hold briefly.
Return to upright.
exercises.note: Use a stable chair, and stop if you feel pinching in your back.

exercises.name: Seated Wrist Flexor Stretch
setup: Hold one arm out in front of you with the palm up.
Use your other hand to hold the fingers.
steps: Gently pull your fingers back toward you.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds while breathing.
Switch arms.
exercises.note: Keep the stretch gentle, and stop if you feel tingling or sharp pain.

exercises.name: Selectorized Overhead Press Machine (Machine)
setup: Adjust the seat so the handles are at shoulder height and sit with your back against the pad.
Grip the handles.
steps: Press the handles overhead until your arms are straight.
Pause.
Lower slowly.
exercises.note: Adjust the seat so your shoulders aren't strained, and use a weight you can control on the way down.

exercises.name: Shadow Boxing
setup: Stand in a staggered stance with your fists up and elbows tucked.
Keep your knees soft.
steps: Throw jabs and crosses at an imaginary target.
Rotate your hips and shoulders with each punch.
Return your hands to guard.
exercises.note: Clear the space around you, and don't snap your elbows straight at the end of a punch.

exercises.name: Side Laterals to Front Raise (Dumbbell)
setup: Hold a light dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing in.
Stand tall with your ribs down.
steps: Raise the dumbbells out to the sides to shoulder height.
Lower them, then raise them forward to shoulder height.
Lower and repeat.
exercises.note: Use light weights and keep your core braced.

exercises.name: Side Plank Lateral Raise (Dumbbell)
setup: Lie on your side on your forearm with your legs stacked and a light dumbbell in your top hand.
Lift your hips into a side plank.
