steps: Raise the dumbbell out and up to shoulder height.
Lower slowly.
Keep your hips lifted throughout.
exercises.note: Use a very light weight, and stop if you feel pain in your supporting shoulder.

exercises.name: Single Leg Glute Bridge
setup: Lie on your back with one knee bent and foot flat, and the other leg extended.
Keep your arms at your sides.
steps: Drive through the heel of the planted foot to lift your hips.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower slowly.
exercises.note: Do all reps on the weaker side first.

exercises.name: Single Legged Romanian Deadlifts
setup: Stand tall on one leg with a soft knee.
Hold a support if needed.
steps: Hinge forward and extend the free leg behind you.
Lower your torso until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Squeeze your glute to stand tall.
cues: Free leg in line with your torso
exercises.note: Hold a support until your balance is steady, and stop the range when your back begins to round.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Cable Fly (Cable)
setup: Set the pulley at shoulder height and stand side-on with the handle in your outer hand.
Take a split stance for balance.
steps: Bring the handle across your body in a hugging arc until it is in front of your chest.
Squeeze your chest.
Return slowly.
mistakes: Letting the cable pull your shoulder forward.
exercises.note: Use a moderate weight and keep your core braced so the cable can't twist you.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Overhead Press (Dumbbell)
setup: Hold a dumbbell at your shoulder with your palm facing forward, feet shoulder width apart.
Brace your core.
steps: Press the dumbbell straight overhead to lockout.
Pause.
Lower slowly to your shoulder.
exercises.note: Use a weight you can press without leaning, and clear the space around you.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Preacher Curl on an Incline Bench Backrest (Dumbbell)
setup: Sit behind an incline bench backrest with your upper arm resting over the top of it.
Hold a dumbbell with your palm up.
steps: Curl the dumbbell toward your shoulder.
Squeeze.
Lower slowly until your arm is nearly straight.
cues: Upper arm stays on the pad
mistakes: Lifting your elbow off the pad.
exercises.note: Don't snap your elbow straight at the bottom, and keep the weight moderate.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Landmine Press (Barbell)
setup: Wedge the bar end into a corner or landmine and hold the other end at your shoulder.
Stand in a staggered stance.
steps: Press the bar up and forward until your arm is straight.
Pause.
Lower slowly to your shoulder.
exercises.note: Make sure the bar end is held securely and can't slip.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Overhead Cable Extension (Cable)
setup: Face away from the stack holding the handle behind your head with your elbow pointing up.
Take a split stance.
steps: Extend your arm up until it is straight.
Squeeze your triceps.
Lower slowly until you feel a stretch.
exercises.note: Keep the weight light, since the overhead position stresses the elbow.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Balance (Ankle Proprioception)
setup: Stand on one leg with a soft knee near a wall for support.
Keep your hips level.
steps: Hold your balance for 30 seconds.
Keep your ankle steady.
Switch legs.
exercises.note: Stay near a wall or rail, and stop if your ankle gives way.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Balance Reach
setup: Stand on one leg with a soft knee.
Hold your arms out.
steps: Hinge forward and reach your hand toward the floor.
Pause.
Return to standing.
exercises.note: Hold a support if your balance is shaky.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Bound
setup: Stand on one leg with a soft knee.
Swing your arms back.
steps: Push off the standing leg and leap forward.
Land on the opposite leg.
Hold the landing for a second.
exercises.note: Warm up first, use a forgiving surface, and stop if your knee or ankle hurts.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift (Deficit) (Dumbbell)
setup: Stand on one leg on a low platform holding a dumbbell in the opposite hand.
Soften your standing knee.
steps: Hinge forward and lower the dumbbell below the platform level.
Pause.
Squeeze your glute to stand.
exercises.note: Use a low, stable platform and hold a support if needed.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Hop
setup: Stand on one leg with a soft knee.
Keep your arms ready to swing.
steps: Hop up and forward on the same leg.
Land softly with a bent knee.
Hold the landing, then repeat.
exercises.note: Warm up first, use a forgiving surface, and stop if your knee or ankle hurts.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Standing Calf Raise
setup: Stand on one leg with the ball of your foot on a step and hold a support.
Keep the other foot off the floor.
steps: Lower your heel into a deep stretch.
Rise onto your toes as high as you can.
Pause, then lower slowly.
mistakes: Rolling to the outside of your foot.
exercises.note: Hold a support, and build up reps gradually.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Step-Down
setup: Stand on a low box on one leg with the other foot hovering.
Keep your hands on your hips.
steps: Lower your free heel toward the floor by bending the standing knee.
Tap lightly.
Stand back up.
exercises.note: Use a low box and hold a support if your balance is shaky.

exercises.name: Sit-Up/Ab Mat Sit-Up
setup: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Place your hands across your chest.
steps: Curl your torso up to sitting.
Pause.
Lower slowly.
exercises.note: Keep it controlled, and stop if you feel strain in your lower back or neck.

exercises.name: Skater Bound
setup: Stand on one leg with a soft knee.
Swing your arms.
steps: Push off sideways and land on the other leg.
Hold the landing for a second.
Repeat side to side like a skater.
exercises.note: Warm up first, use a non-slip surface, and stop if your knee or ankle hurts.

exercises.name: Pull (Sled)
setup: Face the sled and hold the rope or straps.
Keep a staggered stance.
steps: Walk backward while pulling the sled toward you.
Keep your torso tall.
Hand over hand for a set distance.
exercises.note: Keep the weight manageable and the path clear, and stop if your back rounds.

exercises.name: Push/Pull (Sled)
setup: Grip the sled handles with straight arms.
Lean into the sled in a strong stance.
steps: Drive the sled forward with short, powerful steps.
Then turn and pull it back.
Alternate pushing and pulling.
exercises.note: Use a manageable weight on a non-slip surface, and clear the path.

exercises.name: Slider Leg Curl (Slider)
setup: Lie on your back with your heels on sliders and your knees bent.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
steps: Slide your heels away until your legs are nearly straight.
Pull your heels back in.
Keep your hips up.
exercises.note: Use a smooth floor surface, and stop if your hamstring cramps.

exercises.name: Standing Shrugs (Smith machine)
setup: Stand inside the Smith machine and grip the bar overhand shoulder width apart, hanging at your thighs.
Keep your chest tall and the bar close.
steps: Shrug your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Hold for a second.
Lower slowly until your arms are long.
exercises.note: Rehook the bar before stepping away, and keep the safety stops set below your hand height.

exercises.name: Snap-Down Landing
setup: Stand tall with your feet hip width apart.
Keep your arms ready to swing.
steps: Drop quickly into a quarter squat as if landing from a jump.
Freeze in a stable landing position for a second.
Stand tall and repeat.
exercises.note: Keep the drop small, and stop if your knees or ankles feel sore.

exercises.name: Snatch Pull (Barbell)
setup: Take a wide snatch grip and stand with the bar over your midfoot.
Chest up, back flat.
steps: Pull the bar off the floor and keep it close.
Extend your hips and shrug hard.
Pull the bar up high without catching it, then lower it under control.
mistakes: Pulling with your arms before your hips extend.
exercises.note: Use a light bar with a coach, on a platform, and lower the bar under control instead of dropping it.

exercises.name: Snatch-Grip Deadlift (Barbell)
setup: Take a wide snatch grip and set your hips lower than for a normal deadlift.
Keep your chest up and back flat.
steps: Push through your feet to stand tall with the bar.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower the bar under control.
exercises.note: Use a lighter weight than your regular deadlift, since the wide grip forces a deeper starting position.

exercises.name: Snatch-Grip High Pull (Barbell)
setup: Take a wide snatch grip and stand with the bar at mid-thigh.
Keep your chest up and arms long.
steps: Extend your hips and shrug.
Pull the bar up toward your chest with your elbows high and wide.
Lower the bar under control.
mistakes: Pulling with your arms before your hips extend.
exercises.note: Use a light bar, and learn the pull with a coach.

exercises.name: Spider Curl (Dumbbell)
setup: Lie chest down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand and your arms hanging.
Keep your chest on the pad.
steps: Curl the dumbbells toward your shoulders.
Squeeze.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
exercises.note: Don't snap your elbows straight at the bottom, and keep the weight moderate.

exercises.name: Spiderman Stretch
setup: Start in a push-up position.
Keep your core braced.
steps: Step one foot outside your hand, dropping your hips into a lunge.
Rotate your torso and reach the inside arm toward the ceiling.
Return and switch sides.
exercises.note: Move within a comfortable range, and stop if you feel a pinch in your hip or back.

exercises.name: Split Jerk (Barbell)
setup: Rack the bar on your front shoulders with your feet hip width apart.
Brace your core.
steps: Dip slightly.
Drive up explosively and split your feet front and back to catch the bar overhead.
Recover your feet to stand tall, then lower the bar.
mistakes: Pressing out instead of splitting under.
exercises.note: Learn this with a coach, and use bumper plates on a platform so you can drop a missed lift safely.

exercises.name: Split Squat Isometric Hold
setup: Take a split stance with your front foot flat and your back heel lifted.
Keep your torso upright.
steps: Lower your back knee toward the floor until you reach the bottom position.
Hold that position without moving.
Breathe steadily.
mistakes: Letting your front knee cave in.
exercises.note: Hold a support if needed, and stop if your knee hurts.

exercises.name: Squat Thrusts
setup: Stand tall with your feet hip width apart.
Keep your core braced.
steps: Squat down and place your hands on the floor.
Jump or step your feet back into a plank.
Jump your feet back in and stand up.
mistakes: Letting your hips sag in the plank.
exercises.note: Warm up first, and step instead of jump if your wrists or lower back are sore.

exercises.name: Ball Leg Curl (Stability Ball)
setup: Lie on your back with your heels on top of a stability ball.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
steps: Curl the ball toward your glutes by bending your knees.
Pause.
Roll it back out slowly.
exercises.note: Use a mat and a stable ball, and stop if your hamstring cramps.

exercises.name: Standing Alternating Dumbbell Press (Dumbbell)
setup: Stand with feet shoulder width apart and a dumbbell at each shoulder.
Brace your core.
steps: Press one dumbbell overhead to lockout.
Lower it as you press the other.
Keep alternating.
exercises.note: Use a weight you can press without leaning, and clear the space around you.

exercises.name: Standing Cable Hip Abduction (Cable)
setup: Strap the cable to the ankle farthest from the stack and hold the frame.
Stand tall.
steps: Raise your leg out to the side.
Pause.
Lower slowly.
exercises.note: Check the ankle strap is snug and hold the frame firmly.

exercises.name: Standing Dumbbell Press (Dumbbell)
setup: Stand with feet shoulder width apart and a dumbbell at each shoulder, palms forward.
Brace your core.
steps: Press both dumbbells overhead to lockout.
Pause.
Lower slowly to your shoulders.
exercises.note: Use a weight you can press without leaning, and clear the space around you.

exercises.name: Standing Palms-In Dumbbell Press (Dumbbell)
setup: Stand with feet shoulder width apart and a dumbbell at each shoulder, palms facing each other.
Brace your core.
steps: Press both dumbbells overhead with palms facing in.
Pause.
Lower slowly.
exercises.note: Use a weight you can press without leaning, and clear the space around you.

exercises.name: Standing Wall Shoulder Opening Stretch
setup: Stand next to a wall and place your hand flat on it behind you at shoulder height.
Keep your arm straight.
steps: Turn your body away from the wall until you feel a stretch across your chest and shoulder.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds while breathing.
Switch sides.
exercises.note: Keep the stretch gentle, and stop if you feel pain at the front of your shoulder.

exercises.name: Steady State Ride (Cardio)
setup: Set the seat so your knee is slightly bent at the bottom of the pedal stroke.
Wear a helmet and check your brakes.
steps: Ride at a steady pace that you can keep up while talking.
Keep your cadence smooth.
Cool down with a few minutes of easy pedalling.
mistakes: Mashing a gear that is too hard.
exercises.note: Wear a helmet and follow traffic rules if you ride outdoors.

exercises.name: Steady-State Rowing Machine (Machine)
setup: Sit on the seat with your feet strapped in and grip the handle.
Set the damper to a moderate level.
steps: Push through your legs, then lean back and pull the handle to your lower ribs.
Reverse the sequence on the return.
Keep a steady stroke rate.
exercises.note: Warm up first and keep your back flat; stop if your lower back aches.

exercises.name: Step-Down to Balance
setup: Stand on a low step on one leg with the other foot hovering.
Hold your arms out.
steps: Lower your free foot slowly toward the floor by bending the standing knee.
Tap lightly.
Stand tall and hold your balance for a second.
exercises.note: Use a low step and hold a support if your balance is shaky.

exercises.name: Stiff-Legged Dumbbell Deadlift (Dumbbell)
setup: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Keep your knees nearly straight.
steps: Push your hips back and lower the dumbbells along your legs with a flat back.
Pause at a hamstring stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
exercises.note: Brace your core and stop lowering when your back begins to round.

exercises.name: Straight Bar Bench Mid Rows (Barbell)
setup: Lie face down on a high bench with the bar on the floor under you.
Grip it overhand.
steps: Row the bar up to the underside of the bench.
Squeeze your mid back.
Lower slowly.
exercises.note: Set the bench high enough that your arms fully extend, and lower the bar carefully.

exercises.name: Straight-Arm Lat Pulldown (Cable)
setup: Face the stack with the bar in both hands, arms straight overhead.
Hinge slightly with soft knees.
steps: Pull the bar down in an arc to your thighs with straight arms.
Squeeze your lats.
Return slowly.
exercises.note: Use a moderate weight and keep your core braced.

exercises.name: Sumo Deadlift (Barbell)
setup: Stand with a wide stance and toes turned out, the bar over your midfoot.
Grip the bar inside your knees.
steps: Push through your feet to stand tall with the bar.
Squeeze your glutes.
Lower the bar under control.
mistakes: Letting your hips shoot up first.
exercises.note: Brace your core on every rep and set the bar down rather than dropping it.

exercises.name: Supermans
setup: Lie face down with your arms extended overhead and your legs straight.
Keep your neck neutral.
steps: Lift your arms and legs slightly off the floor.
Hold for a second.
Lower slowly.
exercises.note: Keep the lift small, and stop if your lower back pinches.

exercises.name: Swim Kick Drill
setup: Hold a kickboard in front of you in the water.
Keep your body flat on the surface.
steps: Kick your legs from the hips with straight but loose knees.
Keep your face in the water.
Breathe forward.
exercises.note: Swim only where you can do so safely, ideally with a lifeguard on duty.

exercises.name: Swim Pull Drill
setup: Place a pull buoy between your thighs.
Float face down with your arms forward.
steps: Pull with your arms in a freestyle stroke.
Keep your legs still.
Breathe to the side.
exercises.note: Swim only where you can do so safely, ideally with a lifeguard on duty.

exercises.name: Swim Sprint Intervals
setup: Warm up with an easy swim.
Start from a wall.
steps: Swim hard for the work interval.
Rest at the wall.
Repeat for the planned rounds.
exercises.note: Swim only where you can do so safely, and stop if you feel dizzy or breathless.

exercises.name: Tate Press (Dumbbell)
setup: Lie on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand above your chest.
Keep your palms facing forward.
steps: Bend your elbows to lower the dumbbells toward your chest with elbows flared.
Extend your elbows to return.
Keep your upper arms still.
exercises.note: Use a spotter and light weights, and lower the dumbbells carefully since they travel near your chest and face.

exercises.name: Treadmill Tempo Run
setup: Clip the safety key to your clothing and warm up with five minutes of walking.
Keep your posture tall.
steps: Run at a steady, comfortable pace for the planned time.
Keep your stride smooth.
Cool down by slowing to a walk.
exercises.note: Clip the safety key to your clothing, and slow to a walk before stepping off.

exercises.name: Thoracic Extension over Foam Roller (Foam Roller)
setup: Sit on the floor with a foam roller behind your upper back and your knees bent.
Place your hands behind your head.
steps: Lean back over the roller and extend gently.
Hold briefly.
Roll up and move the roller slightly.
exercises.note: Keep the roller on your upper back only, and stop if you feel pain.

exercises.name: Tibialis Raise
setup: Stand with your back against a wall and your heels about a foot away.
Keep your legs straight.
steps: Lift your toes toward your shins.
Hold for a second.
Lower slowly.
exercises.note: Stop if the front of your shin hurts.

exercises.name: Doorframe Row (Towel)
setup: Loop a towel around both sides of a closed sturdy door handle and hold the ends.
Lean back with straight arms.
steps: Pull your chest toward the door, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Pause.
Lower slowly.
exercises.note: Check the door is closed securely, and use a strong towel; don't use a door that can swing open.

exercises.name: Isometric Curls (Towel)
setup: Loop a towel under your foot or around a fixed point and hold the ends.
Stand tall with your elbows at your sides.
steps: Curl against the towel's resistance, pulling with your hands while pressing down with the foot.
Hold for a few seconds.
Relax slowly.
exercises.note: Check the towel is strong, and ease off if you feel pain in your elbow.

exercises.name: Slide Leg Curl (Towel)
setup: Lie on your back with your heels on towels on a smooth floor.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
steps: Slide your heels away until your legs are nearly straight.
Pull your heels back in.
Keep your hips up.
exercises.note: Use a smooth floor, and stop if your hamstring cramps.

exercises.name: Trail Run
setup: Wear trail shoes with good grip.
Bring water and plan your route.
steps: Run at an easy pace, shortening your stride on uneven ground.
Walk the steepest climbs.
Look a few steps ahead.
mistakes: Running too fast for the terrain.
exercises.note: Wear trail shoes, bring water, and tell someone your route; watch for loose rocks and roots.

exercises.name: Trap Bar Carry
setup: Stand inside a trap bar and deadlift it up, holding the handles.
Stand tall with your shoulders back.
steps: Walk forward with steady steps, keeping your ribs over your hips.
Keep your shoulders level.
Set the bar down by bending your knees.
exercises.note: Clear the path first, and set the bar down by bending your knees, not your back.

exercises.name: Trap Bar Shrug
setup: Stand inside a trap bar and deadlift it up, holding the handles.
Keep your arms straight.
steps: Shrug your shoulders straight up.
Hold for a second.
Lower slowly.
exercises.note: Set the bar down by bending your knees, not rounding your back.

exercises.name: Row (TRX)
setup: Hold the handles and lean back with straight arms and your feet planted.
Make a straight line from head to heels.
steps: Pull your chest toward your hands.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly.
exercises.note: Check the straps are securely anchored, and move your feet closer to make it easier.

exercises.name: Squat (TRX)
setup: Hold the handles with straight arms and your feet shoulder width apart.
Lean back slightly for support.
steps: Squat down, using the straps for balance.
Pause.
Stand up through your whole foot.
exercises.note: Check the straps are securely anchored before leaning on them.

exercises.name: Tuck Jumps
setup: Stand tall with your feet hip width apart.
Keep your arms ready to swing.
steps: Swing your arms and jump up, pulling your knees toward your chest.
Land softly with bent knees.
Go straight into the next rep.
exercises.note: Warm up first and land on a forgiving surface; stop if your knees or ankles feel sore.

exercises.name: Turkish Get-Up (Kettlebell)
setup: Lie on your back holding a kettlebell above your chest in one hand, with the same-side knee bent and foot flat.
Keep your other arm out at 45°.
steps: Roll onto your elbow, then your hand, and lift your hips.
Sweep your leg back into a lunge and stand up.
Reverse the steps to return to the floor.
exercises.note: Learn this with no weight first, then a light weight; keep your eyes on the kettlebell.

exercises.name: Turkish Get-Up (Dumbbell)
setup: Lie on your back holding a dumbbell above your chest in one hand, with the same-side knee bent and foot flat.
Keep your other arm out at 45°.
steps: Roll onto your elbow, then your hand, and lift your hips.
Sweep your leg back into a lunge and stand up.
Reverse the steps to return to the floor.
exercises.note: Learn this with no weight first, then a light weight; keep your eyes on the dumbbell.

exercises.name: Two-Arm Kettlebell Military Press (Kettlebell)
setup: Rack two kettlebells at your shoulders with your elbows tucked.
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
steps: Press both kettlebells overhead to lockout.
Pause.
Lower slowly to the rack.
mistakes: Letting the bells flop onto your wrists.
exercises.note: Use lighter kettlebells than dumbbells, and clear the space around you.

exercises.name: Underhand Barbell Row (Barbell)
setup: Grip the bar underhand shoulder width apart and hinge forward to about 45°.
Keep your back flat.
steps: Pull the bar to your lower ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly.
exercises.note: Brace your core and keep your back flat; the underhand grip loads the biceps, so go lighter if your elbows ache.

exercises.name: VersaClimber (Machine)
setup: Step onto the pedals and grip the handles.
Adjust the resistance.
steps: Climb with alternating arm and leg movements.
Keep a steady rhythm.
Slow down to cool down.
exercises.note: Warm up first, and slow down if you feel dizzy or your grip fails.

exercises.name: Walking Knee Hugs
setup: Stand tall with your feet hip width apart.
Keep your balance.
steps: Step forward and lift one knee, hugging it to your chest.
Release and step forward with the other knee.
Keep alternating.
exercises.note: Hold the knee gently, and stop if you feel pain in your hip.

exercises.name: Walking Lunge
setup: Stand tall with your hands on your hips and feet hip width apart.
Keep your chest up.
steps: Step forward and lower your back knee toward the floor.
Push off the front foot to bring the back foot through.
Alternate legs while walking.
mistakes: Letting the front knee cave in.
exercises.note: Walk in a clear area, and hold a support or shorten the stride if your balance is shaky.

exercises.name: Walking Lunge with Twist
setup: Stand tall with your hands together in front of your chest.
Keep your chest up.
steps: Step forward and lower into a lunge.
Rotate your torso over the front leg.
Return to centre and step through with the other leg.
exercises.note: Walk in a clear area, and keep the twist small if your lower back is sensitive.

exercises.name: Wall Ball
setup: Hold a medicine ball at your chest and stand facing a wall about an arm's length away.
Keep your feet shoulder width apart.
steps: Squat down with the ball at your chest.
Drive up and throw the ball at a target on the wall.
Catch it and go straight into the next rep.
exercises.note: Throw only at a solid wall with clear space, and use a ball weight you can catch safely.

exercises.name: Weighted Parallel-Bar Straight-Leg Raise (Dumbbell)
setup: Support yourself on parallel bars with a light dumbbell held between your feet.
Keep your arms straight.
steps: Raise your legs straight in front of you to hip height.
Hold briefly.
Lower slowly.
exercises.note: Hold the dumbbell securely between your feet, and use a very light weight.

exercises.name: Wide Push-Ups
setup: Place your hands on the floor wider than your shoulders.
Make a straight line from head to heels.
steps: Lower your chest toward the floor with elbows angled out.
Pause.
Push back up.
exercises.note: Keep the width comfortable for your shoulders, and drop to your knees if needed.

exercises.name: Wide-Grip Barbell Bench Press (Barbell)
setup: Lie on a flat bench and unrack the bar with a grip wider than shoulder width.
Pull your shoulder blades together.
steps: Lower the bar to your mid chest.
Press back up to lockout.
Keep your shoulder blades pinned.
exercises.note: Use a spotter or rack safeties; a wide grip puts more stress on the shoulders.

exercises.name: Wide-Grip Barbell Curl (Barbell)
setup: Grip the bar underhand wider than shoulder width.
Stand tall with elbows at your sides.
steps: Curl the bar toward your shoulders.
Squeeze.
Lower slowly.
exercises.note: Use a lighter weight than a normal curl, since a wide grip stresses the wrists.

exercises.name: Worlds Greatest Stretch
setup: Step into a deep lunge with your hands on the floor inside your front foot.
Keep your back leg straight.
steps: Rotate your torso and reach the inside arm to the ceiling.
Return the hand and lift your front toes to stretch the hamstring.
Switch sides.
exercises.note: Move within your range, and stop if you feel a pinch in your hip or back.

exercises.name: Wrist Roller (Wrist Roller, Weight Plate)
setup: Hold the roller out in front of you at shoulder height, with the plate hanging on the rope.
Stand tall.
steps: Roll the rope up by rotating your wrists.
Lower it slowly by rolling the opposite way.
Keep your arms level.
exercises.note: Use a light plate, keep your feet clear of it, and stop if you feel pain in your wrists.

exercises.name: Yates Row (Barbell)
setup: Grip the bar underhand just outside shoulder width and hinge to about 45°.
Keep your back flat.
steps: Pull the bar toward your lower stomach.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly.
exercises.note: Brace your core and keep your back flat; go lighter if your elbows or lower back ache.

exercises.name: Z Press (Dumbbell)
setup: Sit on the floor with your legs straight in front of you and a dumbbell in each hand at your shoulders.
Sit tall.
steps: Press the dumbbells overhead to lockout.
Pause.
Lower slowly to your shoulders.
exercises.note: Use lighter weights than a standing press, and clear the space around you.

exercises.name: Zercher Squat (Barbell)
setup: Set the bar in the crooks of your elbows and hold it against your chest.
Stand with feet shoulder width apart.
steps: Brace your core and squat down until your thighs are at least parallel.
Keep your chest tall.
Drive up through your whole foot.
exercises.note: Pad the bar with a towel, set the rack safeties, and start with light weight.

exercises.name: Zottman Curl (Dumbbell)
setup: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand with palms facing forward.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
steps: Curl the dumbbells up with palms up.
At the top, rotate your palms to face down.
Lower slowly with palms down, then rotate back at the bottom.
exercises.note: Use lighter dumbbells than your normal curl, since the reverse lowering loads the forearms.
